description: If the singleton clause \([(p,b)]\) occurs in \(\Gamma\), every satisfying valuation has \(v(p)=b\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.unit_forced.{u} {α : Type u} {p : α} {b : Bool}
  {Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Cnf α} (hunit : [{ atom := p, positive := b }] ∈ Γ)
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (hv : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DpllSatisfiability.Models v Γ) : v p = b
